name: Kickstart
description: Side-on motocross in 3D: bikes as 2D physics bodies on sprung wheel joints with 3D models hung on them, big jumps, flips and tricks, three rivals, a floodlit stadium. Collision layers, torque-driven wheels, riders posed by two-bone reaches, colliding particles, a pitched engine loop, touch pedals. Also runs in a browser.
author: Duarte Peixinho
